_comment: The newest Rotorflight firmware we are prepared to recommend. NOT written automatically: run dev/check_rotorflight_release.py, read what it says, and edit this by hand. 'api' must be <= LDRC.RF_API_VERIFIED in data/app.js before we tell anyone to upgrade — otherwise the pages would be steering people onto byte layouts we have not checked.
line: Rotorflight 2.3 — the release these pages are written and tested against.
